Chapter 6814: There Must Be Something To It

Chapter 6814: There Must Be Something To It

“Frenzy chose to fall and now, they want to violate our holy ground? We will join you.” The ancestral dwarf, Six-foot Monarch, said.

“Golden Lamp shall never fall!” The crowd rallied to his comment.

They knew solidarity was the only way for their home to survive. Frenzy was once a powerful lineage in Golden Lamp. However, their progenitor couldn’t resist temptation and became one with Dark Desire. Thus, his whole lineage fell with him.

Because of this, they had to leave Golden Lamp and become a part of Devouring Alliance.

“Why are they here now?” Ironleaf Ancestor remained calm and asked.

Thunder Emperor and Blaze Ancestor couldn’t help but stare at Li Qiye. The others did the same and frowned after seeing that he was a human.

“You tell them.” Blaze Ancestor said.

“I don’t know.” Li Qiye shrugged.

“Eagle God told us they came for our shrine, but it has been around since the city’s founding.” Tinyleaf City Lord had no choice but to join the conversation.

“What is this shrine?” Six-foot Monarch’s brows furrowed.

His ancient race knew everything about Golden Lamp, especially the most famous treasures.

“Our heirloom to be worshipped, nothing more.” The city lord had no choice but to put down his treasure.

In fact, he didn’t know the truth outside of appreciating its importance and potential.

“Are you from a major clan?” Six-foot asked.

“No, I come from humble beginnings, and it’s not my clan’s heirloom. It belongs to the city.” He smiled wryly.

“Just a normal city.” Ironleaf Ancestor pondered.

“Yes, that’s right.” The city lord said as his knees trembled before the ancient ancestors.

“Why would they want something from there?” Ironleaf found this strange.

“It is a remote region, yes, but also the resting place of Immortal Emperor Fei.” Six-foot had a serious expression. His race knew all the secrets in Golden Lamp.

“The ancient emperor who once led Guardian Alliance? He wasn’t just an emperor.” Blaze Ancestor and Ironleaf were startled.

In Heavenrealm, everyone knew “Immortal Emperor” was a symbol of the nine worlds and thirteen continents, not a cultivation realm.

They kept the old title despite having become an immortal. This also applied to Immortal Emperor Gu Chun, a primordial immortal.

“Incredible, then there must be more to Tinyleaf.” Someone commented.

Moreover, another cultivation appeared in their mind - Immortal Emperor Min Ren.

Regardless of the changes in races and generations, Golden Lamp’s inhabitants couldn’t forget two cultivators - Golden Immortal and Immortal Emperor Min Ren.

The latter launched an expedition against Stygian, putting an end to Mang. This allowed Golden Lamp to survive.

“I thought Immortal Emperor Fei died in battle against Deepsouth Divine Emperor. Did Immortal Emperor Fei leave this shrine behind?” Ironleaf asked.

“I do not know, there, there’s no writing on it.” The city lord shook his head.

“You know more about this?” Thunder Emperor asked Ironleaf.

“I have heard our progenitor talk about it before.” Ironleaf said.

“Goldsilver Tree.” All eyes were on Ironleaf.

Goldsilver Tree was the other pillar in Golden Lamp, a protector just like Bear Immortal. He was an overlord born in Golden Lamp. Alas, he hasn’t appeared in a long time due to depleted lifespan. Given his age, the living fossil knew all the secrets.

“Go on.” Six-foot asked.

“Do you know about the Gate of Wisdom?” Ironleaf asked.

“A legend, is it real?” Thunder Emperor said.

“It’s real.” Six-foot said: “Mang’s direct disciples watched over it. It was a contest between them and an ultimate progenitor from the thirteen continents, a legendary genius with thirteen palaces and peerless dao comprehension. In just a split second, he surpassed two major realms and tried to enter the gate, seeking a primordial artifact.”

“Impossible, two major realms in one go? It can’t be that easy to become an immortal.” Blaze Ancestor didn’t buy it.
